name: Basic study task 038: Chassis full-network route [chongqing_jiefangbei]

relation_definition.longitudinal_cohort: starts near the focal vehicle on its same-direction start segment, or just beyond a compact pedestrian connector, and shares the focal downstream destination; pedestrian followers terminate at the crossing approach so native traffic never pre-empts the authored pedestrian
relation_definition.route_aligned: same physical road segment as the focal route; same-direction lanes are preferred and opposing lanes are used only as a compact-road fallback
relation_definition.crossing: connector conflicts with a connector on the focal route
relation_definition.extra_near_ego_npc: same-destination native SUMO vehicles placed on the focal start segment or its first downstream route lane

daynight_keyframes.description: The local time advances into afternoon daylight.
Dusk begins and ambient light falls.
Night falls and the road becomes dark.
